gemini.value: The Spring Valley quarantine expanded to El Cajon effective June 18, 2026, newly flagging 4 shipments (SR-1003, SR-1007, SR-1012, SR-1015). This update covers a generated zone of about 100.8 sq mi (official: 111.0 sq mi) affecting 338.5 acres of commercial agriculture including avocado, citrus, stone fruit, and tomatoes. Out of the processed shipments, 8 need review, 5 are unclear requiring a human check, 5 have no flag as they are not hosts, and 7 have no flag because they are outside the zone. Operations verified 16 out of 17 citations in this run.
